"""Own strict validation, executed inside the admitted capped scope before Kani."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys,hashlib,tomllib,os
B=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;x=json.loads((B/sys.argv[1]).read_text());a=x['attempt'];S=B/'NBL_src'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
frozen='5782e6a32026fdd95d252d0db7ea20b16716e6deb4f5a397e744886bb6ba22ef'
assert sha(S/'Cargo.lock')==frozen,'STOP frozen lock mismatch before Kani'
pins=json.loads((B/'NBL_SOURCE_PINS.json').read_text())
errors=[n for n,h in pins.items() if sha(S/n)!=h]
(B/(a+'-source-check.json')).write_text(json.dumps(dict(files=len(pins),errors=errors),indent=2)+'\n')
assert not errors,errors
r=subprocess.run(['/home/dombarker/.cargo/bin/cargo','metadata','--locked','--offline','--format-version','1'],cwd=S,capture_output=True,text=True)
(B/(a+'-graph.stderr')).write_text(r.stderr)
assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
m=json.loads(next(l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('{')))
lock=tomllib.loads((S/'Cargo.lock').read_text());key=lambda p:(p['name'],p['version'],p.get('source'))
f={key(p):p for p in lock['package']};actual={key(p):p for p in m['packages']};nodes={p['id']:p for p in m['resolve']['nodes']};pkgs={p['id']:p for p in m['packages']}
added=set(actual)-set(f);missing=set(f)-set(actual)
allowed_missing={('aspis-r1-cert-build','0.0.0',None),('aspis-r1-cert-check','0.0.0',None),('aspis-z4b-probe','0.1.0',None)}
edge_errors=[]
for p in m['packages']:
 for d in nodes[p['id']]['dependencies']:
  q=pkgs[d];ok=False
  for label in f[key(p)].get('dependencies',[]):
   v=label.split(' ')
   if len(v)==1 and sum(k[0]==q['name'] for k in f)>1:continue
   if v[0]==q['name'] and (len(v)<2 or v[1]==q['version']) and (len(v)<3 or v[2].strip('()')==q.get('source')):ok=True
  if not ok:edge_errors.append([key(p),key(q)])
seen=set()
def visit(i):
 if i in seen:return
 seen.add(i)
 for d in nodes[i]['dependencies']:visit(d)
visit(next(p['id'] for p in m['packages'] if p['name']=='aspis-r1-cost-probe'))
out=dict(graph_matches_frozen=not added and not(missing-allowed_missing) and not edge_errors,frozen_packages=len(f),resolved_packages=len(actual),new_package_tuples=sorted(added,key=str),missing_package_tuples=sorted(missing,key=str),edge_errors=edge_errors,lock_sha256=frozen,graph_sha256=hashlib.sha256(r.stdout.encode()).hexdigest(),selected_closure=[dict(name=pkgs[i]['name'],version=pkgs[i]['version'],source=pkgs[i].get('source'),features=nodes[i]['features']) for i in sorted(seen)])
(B/(a+'-graph-check.json')).write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n');assert out['graph_matches_frozen'],out
assert sha(S/'Cargo.lock')==frozen,'STOP metadata changed lock'
status=subprocess.run(x['native_command'],cwd=B).returncode
last=sha(S/'Cargo.lock');(B/(a+'-lock-check.json')).write_text(json.dumps(dict(before=frozen,after=last,unchanged=last==frozen),indent=2)+'\n');assert last==frozen,'STOP Kani changed lock'
sys.exit(status)

"""Executed inside the capped S2W command: strict frozen graph before each run."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,tomllib,os
b=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;s=b/'NBE_src';a=sys.argv[1];harness=sys.argv[2]
lock=s/'Cargo.lock';before=hashlib.sha256(lock.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert before=='5782e6a32026fdd95d252d0db7ea20b16716e6deb4f5a397e744886bb6ba22ef'
with (b/(a+'-metadata.stderr')).open('w') as err:
 r=subprocess.run(['/home/dombarker/.cargo/bin/cargo','metadata','--manifest-path',str(s/'Cargo.toml'),'--locked','--offline','--format-version','1'],capture_output=False,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=err,text=True)
assert r.returncode==0,(r.returncode,(b/(a+'-metadata.stderr')).read_text())
m=json.loads(r.stdout);f=tomllib.loads(lock.read_text());key=lambda p:(p['name'],p['version'],p.get('source'))
frozen={key(p):p for p in f['package']};actual={key(p):p for p in m['packages']};nodes={n['id']:n for n in m['resolve']['nodes']};pkgs={p['id']:p for p in m['packages']}
new=sorted(set(actual)-set(frozen),key=str);edges=[]
for p in m['packages']:
 if key(p) not in frozen:continue
 for depid in nodes[p['id']]['dependencies']:
  d=pkgs[depid];matches=[]
  for label in frozen[key(p)].get('dependencies',[]):
   parts=label.split(' ')
   if parts[0]!=d['name']:continue
   if len(parts)>1 and parts[1]!=d['version']:continue
   if len(parts)==1 and sum(k[0]==d['name'] for k in frozen)>1:continue
   if len(parts)>2 and parts[2].strip('()')!=d.get('source'):continue
   matches.append(label)
  if not matches:edges.append([key(p),key(d)])
out=dict(lock_before=before,new_packages=new,edge_errors=edges,metadata_sha256=hashlib.sha256(r.stdout.encode()).hexdigest(),resolved_packages=len(actual),frozen_packages=len(frozen),allowed=not new and not edges)
(b/(a+'-graph.json')).write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(out),flush=True)
assert out['allowed']
cmd=['/home/dombarker/.cargo/bin/cargo-kani','kani','--manifest-path',str(s/'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/Cargo.toml'),'--target-dir',str(b/'NBE_target'),'--lib','-j','1','-Z','unstable-options','--harness-timeout','90s','--exact','--harness',harness,'--output-format','terse']
print(json.dumps(dict(command=cmd)),flush=True)
r=subprocess.run(cmd,env=os.environ)
after=hashlib.sha256(lock.read_bytes()).hexdigest();out.update(lock_after=after,unchanged=before==after,kani_exit=r.returncode)
(b/(a+'-graph.json')).write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(out),flush=True)
assert after==before,'STOP frozen lock drift'
sys.exit(r.returncode)
